source: Hugging Face official repository API and immutable Git revision resolved on 2026-09-04

models.purpose: Hindsight 0.9.2 official default local embedding model
models.load_policy: Set HINDSIGHT_API_EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=local and HINDSIGHT_API_EMBEDDINGS_LOCAL_MODEL to the immutable local snapshot path; require HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, and trust_remote_code=false.

models.purpose: Hindsight 0.9.2 official default local cross-encoder reranker
models.alias_resolution: The Hindsight source spelling redirects on Hugging Face to the canonical repository below; the local-path substitution preserves the canonical model weights while removing moving-name resolution.
models.load_policy: Set HINDSIGHT_API_RERANKER_PROVIDER=local and HINDSIGHT_API_RERANKER_LOCAL_MODEL to the immutable local snapshot path; require HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, trust_remote_code=false, and fp16=false.

download_policy.scheduler_gate: Do not download either snapshot until the Wave-1 controller is terminal, all Wave-1 model services have stopped, and an independent audit reports no process references either new target.
download_policy.transport: Download directly on the server into the exact project-owned path; if transferred from the Mac, use resumable sftp limited to 4096 Kbit/s.
download_policy.post_download: Verify resolved revision, exact selected paths, per-file bytes, total bytes, and SHA-256 for every local file before any import or lifecycle execution.
download_policy.offline_execution: All later imports and runs must deny network model resolution and load only these local snapshots.
download_policy.cleanup: comparisons/model-retention-policy.v2.json governs cleanup; these project-owned weights become candidates only after accepted numerical evidence and independent archive verification.

evidence_role: immutable model acquisition design only; no downloaded bytes, import success, lifecycle result, numerical result, superiority, or SOTA claim
